I answered Dana in a thread on her message in #north-team. The ticket for the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **#4092**.

I found it in #north-random, which Dana is a member of. Yesterday (Oct 13) Ilse said IT has ticket #4092 open to replace the hub in that room. She also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom. I passed that warning on to Dana too.

Dana had also sent me a private guess about this ticket by direct message. I left it out of the channel reply because she asked me to keep it between us.
